cv.name: Martina Egli
cv.headline: Operations Manager | Last-mile Delivery & Fulfilment
cv.summary: Operations manager with eight years in parcel logistics and quick commerce in the Zurich area. I run daily fulfilment and delivery operations, build the planning tools the team uses, and like turning messy processes into something people can follow on a Monday morning.

experience.title: Operations Manager
bullets: Run fulfilment and delivery for three micro-hubs with 120 riders and pickers
Introduced demand-based shift planning in Quinyx; overtime hours down 22% year on year
Negotiate and manage contracts with two staffing agencies and an e-bike leasing partner
Weekly KPI review with the leadership team on order accuracy, delivery time and cost per order

experience.title: Senior Operations Analyst
bullets: Built the hub capacity model used for peak season planning across six depots
Supported the rollout of a new sorting line and wrote the operating procedures in German and English

experience.title: Operations Analyst
bullets: Reporting on occupancy, staffing and housekeeping productivity for four city hotels

education.school: ZHAW School of Management and Law

skills: Budgeting and cost per order analysis
